expat_policy_notes: Expat Social Security exemption is historically supported in Shanghai (Hu Ren She Han [2021] No. 272). Foreign hires may mutually agree with employers to opt out.
Beijing strictly mandates statutory social security for expat employees unless protected by a bilateral social security totalization treaty (e.g., Germany, Korea, Canada).
